messages:
leandro.prod: Heads-up: were opening a limited expansion for L4p Dedicated capacity in sa-east-1 (So Paulo) to improve latency and cost for LATAM customers. :brazil: 

leandro.prod: Why sa-east-1 L4p? Short tail latency for small-batch chat + low per-token costs for embeddings—ideal for customer apps in LATAM markets that want regional routing.

carol.eng: Tech notes: pool uses 4x L4p cards per host with our low-latency kernel set and automatic prefix caching enabled. Internal perf: ~1.3x p95 improvement for single-token streaming vs current us-east fallback in our tests.

carol.eng: Caveats: for extremely long-context (>64k) seqs batching and KV footprint still favor MI300/A100 families. Also watch HBM utilization on multi-tenant workloads.

diego.ops: Rollout plan: soft expansion starts now under pool tag l4p-saopaulo-latam-preview. Initial capacity is small (8 hosts). Preview is limited-quota and no SLA; GA targeted in ~21 days pending stable telemetry. Please ask customers to request seats via the internal form.

diego.ops: Preview billing tag: preview-l4p-sa-east. Billing team, please hold GA pricing until telemetry review completes.

billing-bot: [billing-note] tag applied: preview-l4p-sa-east to pool l4p-saopaulo-latam-preview by diego.ops at 2026-06-02T14:05:00Z

paula.sales: Sales note: Ill send a one-paragraph AE blurb highlighting improved latency for regional users, low per-token cost for embeddings, and limited preview seats. Will include approval workflow.

carol.eng: Ops checklist:
```
- Add l4p-saopaulo-latam-preview to routing policies with fallback to l4p-us-east and a800-us-east.
- Default per-tenant host cap = 1 in preview; request increases via support.
- Enable prefix/KV caching & monitor HBM pressure metrics.
- Emit latencies to a regional metric bucket (sa-east) for analysis.
```

carol.eng: Quick redwoodctl example to reserve for QA:
```
redwoodctl reservations create --pool pool-l4p-sp-01 --units 1 --duration 7d --justification "sa-east L4p eval"
```

devex-maya: Ill update the dedicated quickstart docs with a LATAM note and suggested config (region=sa-east-1, streaming=true). ETA: tomorrow AM.

leandro.prod: Action items: Carol monitor perf/regression signals; Diego maintain preview whitelist and post weekly snapshots; Paula prepare AE comms; Maya update docs; Billing hold GA pricing. Post customer requests in this thread.

diego.ops: Pool health: GREEN (all nodes reporting)

leandro.prod: Thanks everyone a8b4 : will follow up with an internal FAQ and access link in the next 24h.
